homogeneous_initial_formula.scope: Full row-space equality against independent degree elimination, not just equality of lengths. Pairs are coprime over every checked field; finite checks support the uniform regular-pair proof.

six_channel_rank_model.scope: The six-channel model is checked by commuting cyclic operators, original equations, nilpotent filtration, every free-basis vector and independent full Macaulay kernels. It preserves all ranks of original monomial subsets, not only a list of sampled bases. Characteristic two is covered by the general row-space theorem, not these formulas using 1/2.

existing_fan_replays.scope: Replay existing complete fans in an independently constructed algebra. No larger fan search or extrapolated asymptotic count.

integral_two_channel_rank_model.scope: A classical monic-division basis gives a smaller integral model. Full independent Macaulay kernels cover both cubics over Q and F_2,F_3,F_5,F_101; explicit column maps preserve the previous six-channel model. No cost-ray or new asymptotic theorem follows from this basis alone.

all_field_cubic_boundary_certificates.scope: Complete continuous positive fans at the eight stated cutoffs, over every field: monic integer border relations, exact integer membership witnesses, rational cone endpoints and symmetry/outer-cone coverage. No mesh or selected-characteristic inference is used. The uniform boundary-cover conjecture and an asymptotic fan count for the cubic remain unproved.

scope: Exact truncation and all-subset rank reductions, plus complete positive fans at eight stated cubic cutoffs over every field by monic integer certificates. The finite-free and monic-division ingredients are classical mechanisms. No uniform full-fan count, polynomial separation, unrestricted improvement or completed priority assessment is asserted.
